scientific_integrity: No independent certification or authorship claimed. Historical asymptotic and Eulerian methods are credited; proofs and reproducible finite checks supplied.
scientific_limitations: Binary cyclic read length three only; not the fiber sizes, noisy coding, or other alphabets/read lengths. The leading coefficient 1/288 is known in prior work. Exact all-length generating function has a proof and finite independent checks but no independent audit.
title: Exact cyclic binary three-gram profile enumeration
